description: Perform a read-only pre-flight security check on an unsigned EVM transaction (`to`, `calldata`, `network`) before signing or broadcasting. Screens 4-byte function selectors against unlimited ERC-20 `approve(MAX_UINT256)` (`0x095ea7b3`), NFT `setApprovalForAll(true)` (`0xa22cb465`), Permit2 drainer signatures (`0xd505accf`), UUPS proxy upgrades (`0x3659cfe6`), and verifies whether the spender is an unverified EOA via `eth_getCode`. Does not broadcast any transaction. Returns JSON with `verdict` (`ALLOW`, `WARN`, `BLOCK`), `risk_score` (0-100), decoded `selector`, and actionable `alerts`.

calldata.description: Hex-encoded transaction input data starting with `0x` (e.g. `0x095ea7b3...`). Pass `0x` for native value transfers.

network.description: EVM network identifier where the transaction will be executed (`base`, `arbitrum`, `polygon`, `ethereum`, `optimism`, `bsc`). Defaults to `base`.

to.description: 42-character hexadecimal target contract or recipient address (`0x...`) of the unsigned EVM transaction.

name: check_tx_firewall
